# Support

## Public Contact

- General enquiries: info@cs-agency.com.au
- Website: https://cs-agency.com.au

## Security Issues

For security vulnerabilities, do not use public issue threads.  
Use `.github/SECURITY.md` and `security@cs-agency.com.au`.

## Repository Scope

This repository is for the public digital headquarters and approved institutional content.  
Requests for controlled enterprise materials are outside public repository scope.
